items.description:
Company Description
Nammos World is a luxury hospitality brand with locations around the globe.
Started back in 2003 the brand's flagship location is in Mykonos and it also has venues in Dubai, Limassol, Cannes and soon-to-open venues in London. Nammos World provides luxury beach settings, fine dining gastronomy, luxurious cabanas, and the latest fashion trends in Nammos Village.
Join our international team as a Reservations Manager.
Role Description
Reservations Manager responsibilities include:

Answer phones and assist customers in making, altering, or canceling reservations
Respond to emails with reservation information, confirmations, and additional details
Ensure that all customer inquiries are handled timely, efficiently, and with care
Allocate daily tasks to Reservations Department
Handle pre-payment for F&B reservations and special events bookings if needed
Be fully aware at all times of the rates, packages, groups, and booking status of the restaurant
Maintain effective office administrative procedures within the department that will safeguard and detect double-bookings, non-guaranteed bookings, filing errors, and other inaccuracies

Qualifications

Proven 4 years of work experience as a Reservations Manager in upscale, high-end restaurant or hotel
Excellent Knowledge of English. Knowledge of additional foreign languages will be considered as an advantage
Outstanding attention to detail, encouraging a culture of high standards throughout the team
Experience of working in a highly customer focused service delivery role
Ability to work independently, as well as lead, manage, and motivate a team
Excellent problem solving and customer service skills
Degree in Hospitality/Tourism is an asset.

Benefits
Nammos Group offers a competitive salary with international career development opportunities in our properties Worldwide.
By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work in a stimulating and motivating environment that values and is committed to its employees.
Nammos Group provides a beneficial 12-month employment contract including accommodation, on-duty meals, transport to/from the restaurant.

items.description:
Pfizer careers are like no other. In our culture of individual ownership, we believe in our ability to improve future healthcare, and potential to transform millions of lives. We’re looking for new talent to join our global community, to unearth new innovative therapies that make the world a healthier place.

Work with Principal Engineer of Global Supply to identify the latest technologies in AI Engineering.
Design, pilot, incubate, and work with product and solution teams to implement scalable AI solutions to improve manufacturing operations, processes, and product quality.

Work closely with AIDA to establish and maintain a framework that supports data accessibility and accountability across the organization and aligns with standards across the broader Digital organization.

Adhere to GMP guidelines and processes to reduce production risks and ensure our outputs align with PGS business requirements.
Work with stakeholders in broader Digital to develop and maintain an analytics framework to enhance decision-making and operational efficiency.
Work with stakeholders in broader Digital to establish and maintain governance frameworks to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and security, supporting the organization's strategic objectives and compliance requirements.
Work with solution teams to ensure seamless integration of analytics with existing manufacturing systems for real-time data processing
Manage the operational aspects of AI solutions in manufacturing to ensure reliability, efficiency, and sustainability.
Work with product and business teams to ensure implementation of best practices for AI operations to optimize performance and minimize downtime.


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 15 years of experience in manufacturing operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
Demonstrated expertise in AI/ML, analytics, cloud, and AR/VR technologies in a manufacturing context.
Proven leadership in sustainability and operational efficiency.
Proven experience with ML Ops, cloud computing, technical operations, and data integration.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic digital initiatives that integrate with and enhance core manufacturing processes.
Certifications in Project Management (e.g., PMP), Cloud Technologies (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect), or related fields.
Expertise in implementing scalable machine learning solutions.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to solve complex technical problems.
Excellent communication and people skills.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $191,300.00 to $318,800.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 22.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States.
